title: Design System: Briefing de Clínica de Estética

display.purpose: Main module titles and primary headings.

label.purpose: Meta tags and uppercase section labels.

motion.name: ease-fast
motion.purpose: Quick state transitions and button hovers.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid obsidian black button for primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #09090b; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid #09090b; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: transparent; color: #09090b; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Light gray secondary button for navigation and filters.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fafafa; color: #09090b; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #09090b; background: #f4f4f5; }

narrative.overview: A high-contrast, editorial black-and-white design system tailored for aesthetic clinic intake and strategy.

rules.name: The Monochromatic Principle
rules.body: Colored backgrounds and decorative gradients are forbidden.

rules.name: The Single Face Rule
rules.body: Inter is the exclusive typeface for all UI components.

rules.name: The Border-Over-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Containers use 1px solid borders for visual definition rather than ambient box-shadows.

dos: Do maintain strict WCAG AAA contrast ratios using #09090B on #FFFFFF.
Do use Inter for all typography without exception.
donts: Don't use colored gradients, pastel fills, or shadow overlays.
Don't introduce secondary serif or handwritten font families.
